{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once, with their latest test
# The highest sample_seq is the one that supersedes earlier ones

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prepare for deduplication
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (i.e., highest sample_seq) row for each
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate_dedup)

# Compute the fraction who responded
responded_fraction = control_moderate_dedup['responded'].mean()

# Return results
{'n_control_moderate': n_control_moderate, 'responded_fraction': responded_fraction}"}
